response: Ward A (Colaba, Fort, Churchgate) billed Rs 1655330 against a monsoon road repair budget of Rs 1600000, using 103.5% of it across 29 jobs. 37.9% of jobs were reopened within 30 days, and 65.5% met their repair deadline. Rs 363827 was billed on DLP roads. DLP means the road is still under the original contractor's warranty, so repairs should cost the city nothing. These bills should be checked. One job was priced more than 30% above the rate card and needs review. Work order WO25-00645 is an example to look at. The top contractor by spend was Mithi Infra Projects (synthetic). The city had 18 days of heavy or worse rain this season, which may explain some reopened repairs. The ward's low lying index is 0.35. A ward officer can ask for the paperwork on WO25-00645 and why the Rs 363827 on DLP roads was not claimed under warranty.
